name: Password Generator
description: Generate strong random passwords with a cryptographically secure random source.

hints.customCharset: A custom character set overrides the set selection above; "require each class" and policy templates are then unavailable.
hints.requireEachClass: When enabled, every enabled character set appears at least once.
hints.template: A policy template only fills in the character sets and "require each class" you did not set explicitly; it disables the set selection.
hints.excludeChars: Removed from the character pool after "exclude ambiguous characters", up to 64 characters.

faq.a: At least 60 bits for ordinary services, at least 80 bits for important accounts.
